newsitem.title: USA: COPPER--U.S demand hums along despite futures rout.
newsitem.headline: COPPER--U.S demand hums along despite futures rout.

text.p: The tumble in copper futures since the end of August has wiped some 10 cents off COMEX but not off the face of U.S. physical demand which continues to hum along.

"The third quarter is going to be stronger than we saw in the third quarter of last year - we have had record rod sales and, barring a surge in interest rates, we expect a strong fourth quarter," a sales executive for a U.S. producer said.
A cathode trader added, "People who make wire and cable continue to be very busy, and the only dark cloud is a possible strike at a car company."
